_comment: t/3646 — SSOT MIRROR of main's required status checks. This file is a DESCRIPTION, not
the source of truth. GitHub branch protection is AUTHORITATIVE:
Hand-editing this file changes NOTHING real — it only changes what workflow-lint enforces.
operations/devops/Test-RequiredContextsListDrift.ps1 validates this list against the live
API; that drift-guard MUST be green on main BEFORE the workflow-lint required-context rule
is promoted from warn-only to blocking (a lint enforcing a stale mirror is worse than none).
'workflow: null' is DELIBERATE and load-bearing for CodeQL — do NOT 'correct' it to point at
.github/workflows/codeql.yml (that HARD-FAILS the lint; verified t/3688 AC-2). Rules R2/R5 key on
a job whose id equals the context name; codeql.yml's only job id is 'analyze', and the 'CodeQL'
required context is posted by the GitHub app as an aggregate — so a non-null entry makes R2 fail
with 'no job with id CodeQL'. COST of the null, stated so it is not rediscovered: R1/R4 do NOT
lint codeql.yml, so R1's anti-strand guard (no trigger-level PR paths) — which codeql.yml's own
t/2025 comment relies on — is protected by that comment ALONE, not mechanized. Closing that gap
needs the schema to separate 'file backing a context' (R1/R4) from 'job posting it' (R2/R5): t/3691.
